三套甲拆成一套，扣子都对不上。: Three suits made into one; the buckles never line up.
不开刃，打在身上也不留口子。: No edge, so it leaves no cuts.
先敲开冰，再敲开别的。: First it cracks the ice, then other things.
六面都是好点数的那一颗，找不到了。: The one with good numbers on every face went missing.
冻住的东西，一刀就开。: Anything frozen opens in one cut.
出拳够快的人，刀只需要很短。: Fast enough fists only need a short blade.
刀柄上有编号，登记在册。: The hilt is numbered and on record.
刀柄缠的红绳，是哪一家的颜色？: The red cord on the hilt: whose colors are they?
刀柄里嵌着一枚拆下来的施术单元，握久了手心发烫。: A salvaged Arts unit sits in the hilt; hold it long and your palm burns.
刀法比刀老，刀也比城老。: The style is older than the blade, and the blade older than the city.
刀背上还留着焊缝。: The weld seam still shows on the spine.
刀身太长，只能用双手，也只能用一辈子。: Too long for one hand, and for more than one lifetime.
刀鞘不见了，刀还记得它是追人用的。: The scabbard is gone; the blade still remembers chasing people.
刻痕被很多只手摸平了。: Many hands have worn the carvings smooth.
南边城市造的刀，走到这里已经不像南边的了。: Forged in a southern city; by now it looks nothing like the south.
厚得能挡住冻原的风，挡不住矿石病。: Thick enough to stop the tundra wind, not Oripathy.
吹响以后，往哪边跑都对。: Once it blows, any direction you run is right.
吹响时，林子会安静一下。: When it sounds, the forest goes quiet for a moment.
商贩说它挡过一刀。: The vendor says it once stopped a blade.
在矿里，它买不到任何东西。: Down in the mine, it buys nothing.
型号停产很多年了，刃口没停过。: The model went out of production years ago; the edge never stopped.
埋在冻土下面，刃口依然是冷的。: Buried under the permafrost, the edge is still cold.
墙上用红漆写过一个字，后来墙没了。: Someone wrote a word on the wall in red paint. Then the wall was gone.
它们挤在一起时，比任何皮袄都暖。: Huddled together, they are warmer than any fur coat.
屏幕上还有信号，飞机不知道在哪。: Still a signal on screen; nobody knows where the drone is.
当掉的东西没赎回来，牌子倒留下了。: The pawned item was never redeemed, but the token stayed.
战士们把骨头绑在前臂上，省得刀被打落。: Warriors bind bone to their forearms so no blade can be knocked away.
扣环上写着上一个人的血型。: The buckle bears the last owner's blood type.
披上它，矿道里就少了一个人。: Put it on, and the tunnels have one less person.
披上它，雪地里远远就能认出你是自己人。: Wear it, and friends know you from afar in the snow.
挂在背心上的小东西，谁都有一个。: A trinket on the vest. Everyone has one.
指节上的磨痕，比铜还亮。: The worn knuckles shine brighter than the brass.
插板缺了一块，正好是挨过的那一块。: One plate is missing: the one that took the hit.
握久了，会忘记为什么握着它。: Hold it long enough and you forget why you hold it.
握柄上的手印不是现在这只手的。: The handprint on the grip belongs to another hand.
摇一摇，还剩一口。: Give it a shake: one sip left.
摸上去是温的，最好别摸。: It feels warm to the touch. Better not touch it.
敲鼓的人不在了，鼓槌还记得节拍。: The drummer is gone; the stick still keeps the beat.
斧刃上的漆是南边的颜色。: The paint on the axe head is a southern color.
有人用技艺烧出来的，冷了以后还在发光。: Fired by someone's Arts; it still glows after cooling.
本来是拧热泵阀门的。: It was made for heat pump valves.
本来是用来挂住自己的。: It was meant to hold yourself on the ice.
林子里长出来的东西，林子里的病碰不到它。: What grows in the forest is safe from the forest's sickness.
柄是木头，刃是旧的，路是自己走的。: Wooden haft, old blade, and a road walked alone.
标签上写的温度，这里早就低过了。: It's long been colder here than the label's rating.
树倒了以后，部族的人每人分了一片。: When the tree fell, each clan member took a piece.
每一根羽毛都在等一场雪。: Every feather is waiting for a snowfall.
每一片骨头，都来自一只认得这片林子的兽。: Every bone came from a beast that knew this forest.
每一颗都有过一个名字。: Each one once had a name.
毛朝里穿，雪就进不来。: Fur side in, and the snow stays out.
求平安的人，未必平安，但符留下来了。: Those who prayed for safety weren't always safe, but the charm remains.
洗不掉的部分，就当是颜色。: What won't wash out, call it the color.
滤芯是黑的，说明它一直在工作。: The filter is black, so it has been working.
点烟用的，也点别的。: For lighting cigarettes, and other things.
燃料早就烧完了，背带还结实。: The fuel ran out long ago; the straps still hold.
牙还在，咬合的力气也还在。: The teeth are still there, and so is the bite.
皮要剥得完整，这是猎人对猎物的礼数。: Skin it whole: a hunter's courtesy to the prey.
矛杆上的编号是一个营。: The number on the shaft is a battalion.
矿场配发的开路刀，砍支架也砍人。: A mine-issue machete; it cuts props and people alike.
矿车上拆下来的链节，一圈一圈缠紧。: Chain links from a mine cart, wrapped tight, loop by loop.
穿上它就不用跑了，反正也跑不动。: In this you don't need to run. You can't anyway.
穿上它的人不需要名字。: Whoever wears it needs no name.
线缆另一头接着的东西，早就冻住了。: Whatever is at the cable's other end froze long ago.
给最深的矿道准备的，没来得及发下去。: Made for the deepest shafts, never handed out.
绳子的另一头，通常没有人。: Usually nobody is on the other end of the rope.
绸子挡不住刀，挡刀的是别的东西。: Silk stops no blade. Something else does.
缴获来的，编号被锉掉了。: Captured; the serial number is filed off.
罐子、管子、面罩，一样都不能少。: Canister, hose, mask: none can be missing.
罗德岛测绘队的仪器，指针一直贴在头上。: A Rhodes Island survey tool; the needle stays pinned.
肩上的局徽被刮过，但没刮干净。: The shoulder badge was scraped off, but not cleanly.
胸口缝着矿场的编号。: A mine number is sewn on the chest.
衣服换过三次，师父没换过。: Three uniforms so far, one master.
补丁比原布多，扣子一颗不少。: More patch than cloth, but not a button missing.
袖口被烧穿过，从里面。: The cuffs were burnt through. From inside.
角兽自己脱下来的角，比砍下来的重。: A horn the hornbeast shed itself weighs more than one cut off.
角兽走在前面，铃声替它认路。: The hornbeast walks ahead; the bell finds the way.
角是向林子借的，用完要还。: The antler is borrowed from the forest and must be returned.
警员们说，最好别让它出手。: Officers say it's best it never comes out.
设计时只想过倒下来的树。: It was designed with only falling trees in mind.
读不懂上面的字，但它好像读得懂你。: You can't read its script, but it seems to read you.
货要准时到，人要活着到。: The cargo arrives on time; the courier arrives alive.
趴在雪里时，和灌木没有分别。: Lying in the snow, you look like any shrub.
这身护甲的上一任主人，任期没满两年。: Its last owner didn't serve two full years.
透过它看出去的人，都没有回来。: No one who looked out through it came back.
那天烧得最厉害的地方，他们最先进去。: That day, they went first into the worst of the fire.
里面的钱早花完了，钱夹本身倒值钱。: The money is long spent; the wallet is worth something.
钩背上的磨痕不是砍出来的，是拖出来的。: The wear on the hook comes from dragging, not cutting.
铁皮压的，比戴它的人结实。: Pressed tin, sturdier than its wearer.
锹口磨过，柄上还沾着冻土。: The blade is sharpened; frozen soil still clings to the handle.
镐头断了一半，剩下那半磨成了斧。: Half the pick broke off; the rest was ground into an axe.
门开了，门后的东西也是。: The door opened, and so did what was behind it.
门锁着的时候，它就是钥匙。: When the door is locked, this is the key.
隔着一臂远，猎物才不会回头咬你。: Keep an arm's length, and the prey can't turn and bite.
雨从不停，巡逻也不停。: The rain never stops, and neither does the patrol.
面具都一样，所以没人记得谁倒下了。: All masks look alike, so no one recalls who fell.
频道里只剩杂音，偶尔有人报位置。: Only static on the channel, and now and then a position.
